headline: Across 13 open-source agent repositories, 20.3% of the 158 write-capable tool definitions they ship are never referenced by any test.
secondary_repo_level: 7.7% of those 13 repositories (1) have no test touching any write tool at all.

sensitivity_exhaustive_test_scan_only.note: Restricted to repositories whose entire test suite was read (no cap applied), so a missed reference cannot be an artefact of sampling. The headline is credible to the extent this figure matches it.
